name: Ratio-constrained marginal-preserving pairing stress test

a.assumption: Among assignments compatible with the marginals, physical ordering, and mean ratio, favor pairings that place fewer people at non-HDL >=160 mg/dL.

b.assumption: Among the same compatible assignments, favor pairings that place more people at non-HDL >=160 mg/dL.

interpretation: Two boundary-focused assignment assumptions, not clinical dependence models or certified global bounds. No prevalence target is imposed. Each invocation constructs both scenarios with the supplied seed and returns the requested scenario, with comparative diagnostics in DataFrame.attrs.
